findings.title: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in Jinja2 — RCE / Flag Extraction
findings.description: The `username` query parameter is rendered directly inside a Jinja2 template without sanitization. An attacker can inject template expressions that are evaluated server-side, enabling arbitrary code execution. The Jinja2 built-in `cycler` object exposes `__globals__` which includes the `os` module, providing a clean RCE primitive without needing Flask-specific globals.
